# East Anglia AI Services

> Specialist AI automation consultancy delivering custom AI agents, workflow automation, predictive intelligence, LLM integration, data pipelines, AI ops and AI training for small and medium businesses across Norfolk, Suffolk, Cambridgeshire and Essex (UK). Founded in Norwich in 2026 by Petar Petkov (Founder & AI Automation Consultant) and Magdalena Peeva (Co-founder & Director).

East Anglia AI Services (EAAIS) builds and deploys production AI systems for SMEs — not generic software, but automation designed around how a specific business already works. Typical engagements: invoice-processing automation, AI voice agents for customer service, predictive demand forecasting, LLM-powered chatbots grounded in a company's own documents, continuous AI ops monitoring for deployed models, and hands-on AI training for staff. Projects typically go from discovery to a live system in a matter of weeks. Registered office: 44 Amderley Drive, Norwich, NR4 6HZ (East Anglia AI Services Ltd, company no. 17381169). Prices start from £295 (leadership AI briefing), £595 (team AI training), £1,500 (workflow automation pilot) and £1,200 + £149/month (AI voice agent); every project gets a fixed written quote. Contact: info@eastangliaaiservices.co.uk, +44 7466 951175. Google Business Profile: https://maps.app.goo.gl/rdxBxaq8md67cA9Q7

- [Buy, Rent, Subscribe or Ask First?](https://eastangliaaiservices.co.uk/blog/ai-consultant-vs-buy-rent-subscribe-east-anglia.html): Why talking to an AI specialist beats chasing the "best" AI model off the shelf.

## Service area

Norfolk, Suffolk, Cambridgeshire, Essex — including Norwich, Ipswich, Cambridge, Colchester, Peterborough, Bury St Edmunds, Chelmsford and King's Lynn. Remote delivery is available UK-wide.
